limitations: L4 is offline synthetic arithmetic acceptance only; no physical, chemical, clinical or safety validity is established.
Mean-log-response t intervals assume a linear log-rate relation and appropriate error precision; they are not future-rate or lifetime intervals.
Classical pure-error lack-of-fit is unavailable for unbalanced replicates, variance weighting or zero pure-error variance.
Hashes cannot prove historical freeze timing or independence, and falsely labelled kelvin cannot be identified without trustworthy source identities. Independent review stays unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, shelf life, process safety, reaction order and safe*. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims; a single synthetic fixture cannot establish replication.
Inputs are read-only and bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values. Hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
